source: User accepted proposed priority rows in agent-session-automation-and-efficiency after confirming decision_build remains planned but not implemented.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

requirements.text: Policy-required new_session/context_refresh boundaries should be executed by the agent/adapter automatically when host capabilities allow, without asking the user to paste or press Enter on a command.
If host limitations prevent automatic session creation/reset, CodeWiki must record a precise platform block/fallback instead of presenting the compatibility command as normal user work.
Workflow efficiency must be a roadmap success criterion measured by fewer user interrupts, fewer manual commands, shorter closure path, clear finish reports, and bounded loop/session/write cost.
Session automation and workflow-friction reduction take priority over TASK-001 decision_build implementation until the next roadmap alignment says otherwise.

summary: Accepted priority: automatic session boundaries and CodeWiki workflow efficiency.

diff_table.current_state: CodeWiki can stage session handoff boundaries, but Pi compatibility still may require /wiki-session-handoff or user-visible command entry/Enter in some paths.
diff_table.desired_state: Agent/adapters should create fresh sessions or context resets automatically when policy requires them, using Pi command context or host-supported orchestration without asking the user to paste/press a chat command. User-visible command fallback should be exceptional and explicitly blocked by platform limitations.
diff_table.rationale: Session boundaries are internal workflow mechanics. Making the user press Enter breaks autonomy and makes CodeWiki feel slower than normal AI software development.
diff_table.risk: Pi APIs may not expose true new terminal/session creation in every context; implementation must distinguish supported automatic paths from honest platform-limited fallback.
alternatives: Keep staged command fallback but improve wording.
Only automate context reset, not true new session creation.

diff_table.current_state: The active sprint says CodeWiki vNext should improve workflow efficiency, but current user experience still has heavy ceremony: diff tables, handoffs, validation, publisher gates, and manual session steps.
diff_table.desired_state: Add an explicit efficiency/friction objective to the roadmap: fewer user interrupts, fewer manual commands, shorter task-close path, clear finish report, and measurable limits for loops/sessions/writes before CodeWiki is considered more efficient than plain agent coding.
diff_table.rationale: Efficiency must be user-visible, not just internally traceable. If process feels heavier, roadmap success criteria are wrong or incomplete.
diff_table.risk: Over-optimizing ceremony could weaken traceability if fast paths are not policy-bounded.
alternatives: Treat this as TASK-004 graph lens simplification only.
Keep current roadmap and handle friction informally.

diff_table.current_state: CodeWiki state suggests TASK-001 next, while user says automatic session creation and efficiency should take priority now.
diff_table.desired_state: Reprioritize active roadmap so session automation and workflow-efficiency friction fixes are the next executable work, likely by refining TASK-005 or creating a new high-priority task if TASK-005 scope is too narrow.
diff_table.rationale: Roadmap should follow current user pain. Decision-build work should not outrank making the agent stop asking the user to run internal session commands.
diff_table.risk: Refining TASK-005 may overload a tool-surface cleanup task; creating a new task may duplicate existing TASK-006/TASK-005 intent unless scoped tightly.
alternatives: Keep TASK-001 next but add these as acceptance criteria.
Create a separate urgent hotfix task for automatic sessions only.

accepted_decisions.summary: Prioritize automatic agent-owned session/context boundary execution over decision_build implementation.
Add user-visible workflow efficiency/friction criteria to CodeWiki vNext planning.
Create or refine the next executable roadmap task so session automation and workflow friction become next work.

assumptions: The next executable work should be narrow enough to improve session boundary UX without implementing all decision_build or graph-lens vNext work.
Pi may need command-context or extension-level orchestration changes; true separate terminal creation may remain unsupported and must be reported honestly.
non_goals: Do not implement full decision_build compiler in this priority slice.
Do not weaken validation/task-close/publication proof gates.
Do not hide platform limitations behind fake automation.

knowledge: Clarify automatic session boundary and efficiency success criteria in system/product KB if existing clauses are not strong enough.
roadmap: Create a high-priority executable task or refine TASK-005 so this work is next.
